verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST API that lists action items, with scope filters and an updated_at change window, plus registrable webhooks that POST to your URL when an AI note is generated. An agent or integration can therefore pull each meeting's action items and push them to a tracker. However, Fellow ships no native Linear/Jira/Asana sync and no in-product rules engine, so the integrator must build the receiving and filing logic. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations or automations, a documented action-item-created webhook event, any first-party example of filing into Linear/Jira/Asana, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: List action items with optional filters and pagination.
When an event happens (like an AI note being generated or an action item being completed), Fellow sends an HTTP POST request to the URL you specify with details about the event.
To page through a window of changes, combine `updated_at_start` with `order_by: updated_at_asc`.
This enables you to build integrations that react immediately to changes in Fellow, without needing to poll for updates.
